transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. I'm here to help you. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for the last seven months. I just feel completely empty inside, like all my emotions have been drained away. It's been so hard to keep going like this.

During these past seven months, have you ever experienced periods lasting a few days where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or productive, to the point where you needed much less sleep than usual?

Yes, I actually had a time like that, but it lasted much longer than just a few days—it went on for about five months. During that period, I felt this overflowing energy where I was constantly active and just couldn't sit still. I was always starting new projects and felt like I didn't need to rest at all.

During those five months, did this elevated mood and high energy level cause such significant problems in your daily life, work, or relationships that you required hospitalization or were unable to function at all?

I'm not really sure if it reached the point of needing hospitalization, but I definitely felt very different and hyperactive during that time. I was just constantly on the go and couldn't seem to slow down.

Did this period of high energy cause noticeable disruptions, such as getting into serious conflicts with others, getting into trouble at work, or being unable to complete your normal daily responsibilities?

Yes, it caused a lot of problems because I became extremely irritable during that time. I would get really angry and aggressive over the smallest things, which led to a lot of arguments with my family and coworkers.
Did these arguments and conflicts result in you being fired from your job, losing your employment, or experiencing a complete breakdown in your primary relationships?

No, I didn't end up getting fired or experiencing a complete breakdown in my relationships. However, things became incredibly tense and strained with my family and coworkers during those months. It was a really difficult and stressful time for everyone involved.
During that five-month period of high energy, did you ever experience any unusual sensations, hear voices that others couldn't hear, or hold beliefs that were clearly not based in reality?

Yes, during those five months, I definitely heard voices when no one was there and believed I was a uniquely special person being monitored by others. However, those strange experiences only happened during that high-energy period and completely stopped once I became depressed.
